name: mcp-quotes
description: Send a client a real quote in seconds: line items with VAT, a validity date, a plain-text version to paste into email and an A4 PDF. Accepting a quote turns it into an invoice with the same numbers. All local.

license_key.title: License key
license_key.description: Optional Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Leave blank to use the free tier.

tools.name: quote_create
tools.description: Quote a client: line items with quantity and unit price in minor units, VAT per line or the business default, an optional discount and a validity window. Returns the quote id and the totals.

tools.name: quote_list
tools.description: Every quote with its client, total, validity and state (open, expired, accepted or declined). Filter by state, by client or by quote date range.

tools.name: quote_get
tools.description: The full stored record for one quote: every line with its unit price and VAT, the totals, the validity date, the notes and, when it was accepted, the invoice it became.

tools.name: quote_update
tools.description: Revise a quote that is still open: line items, currency, discount, VAT default, validity or notes. Totals are recomputed. An accepted or declined quote is never edited.

tools.name: quote_send_text
tools.description: Turn a quote into a plain-text summary with the line table, the VAT lines, the total and the validity date, ready to paste into an email. Free on every tier.

tools.name: quote_accept
tools.description: Mark a quote accepted and turn it into an invoice: created directly in the invoice server when its store is present, otherwise returned as invoice_create-ready line items. The numbers are copied, never recomputed.

tools.name: quote_decline
tools.description: Mark a quote as lost, with an optional reason, so it stops counting against the open quotes and shows up in the win rate. An accepted quote is never turned back.

tools.name: quote_pdf
tools.description: Call this tool to write the A4 PDF of one quote and return the file path. Same layout as the invoice PDF, with the validity date and an acceptance block. Pro.

tools.name: quote_report
tools.description: Totals per currency for open, accepted, declined and expired quotes, with counts, the value still open and the win rate. Free covers the current calendar year to date; Pro reports over any date range.

tools.name: license_status
tools.description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

tools.name: license_activate
tools.description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.
